title: Bind the periodic Gaussian Reference family to a cyclic direct solver
body:
Bind the complete narrow periodic Gaussian Reference family to a direct cyclic-band solve. The previous direct consumer covers one 385-row fixture. This result supports every original Reference parameter tuple that passes its explicit positive-gap and analytic-error gates, including multiple holes and arbitrarily small funded gaps. It retains every periodic and cross-cell coefficient, returns every target coordinate, and copies holes exactly.

The [written proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/234142af90b5e7afe0b33c4b78c3c0bd622d5fc3/research/periodic-gaussian-uniform-solve/PROOF.md), [consumer](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/234142af90b5e7afe0b33c4b78c3c0bd622d5fc3/research/periodic-gaussian-uniform-solve/consumer.py), and [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/234142af90b5e7afe0b33c4b78c3c0bd622d5fc3/research/periodic-gaussian-uniform-solve/RESULT.json) define the result. Analytic source error, coefficient rounding, the direct solve and final grid rounding receive separate allowances. The gap is rounded down adaptively; there is no fixed 16-bit gap floor. Preparation rejects an unfunded source.

For source size n, retained halfwidth w and target period N, the retained solver uses at most 4nw² factor products and 8nw products per complex solve. Full input/output scans, gather/scatter, final truncations, buffer clearing, source formation and retained caches/factors remain paid. This is an all-parameter **conditional source/consumer interface**, not production parameter funding or a physical tape tariff. The analytic Reference and interval contracts remain inherited. It does not improve complete kappa or change the selected frontier, whose conditional value remains 60403/20000000.

Base and all live source inputs are pinned to `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`. Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml) supplies the [unchanged Reference](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/rational-unitary-fft/gaussian_reference.py). JoyboyBrian supplies the original source/error interface in [PR #5159](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5159) and the weighted recurrence in [PR #5216](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5216). Ali Romman's [PR #5260](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5260), at `65cdd6b36e002ce9d13bd96dbc504da90f77f2c9`, supplies the fixed-source direct predecessor. His [PR #5284](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5284), consumed at `72269696a9c5ae5b1c0b469afdd3db08080635cf`, supplies the unchanged cyclic solver and precision theorem, retained in this branch's ancestry. Dugongue's [PR #4554](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4554) and Ryanson Jonathan's audit supply the earlier band/Woodbury scope. [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/234142af90b5e7afe0b33c4b78c3c0bd622d5fc3/research/periodic-gaussian-uniform-solve/SOURCES.json) retain the Gaussian, interval and classical elimination credit. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Python 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/periodic-gaussian-uniform-solve
```

Both registered isolated, warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass with `PASS_PERIODIC_GAUSSIAN_UNIFORM_SOLVE`. Eight actual sources, 103,717 original entries, 24 signed complex RHS cases, six separate dense rational solves, eleven rejection controls and seven gap cases pass. Four code mutations fail in both modes. The 258-row fixture uses 492 factor products and 1,314 solve products, with source setup recorded separately. Original-matrix internal residuals plus final rounding certify every finite target. The final-grid residual alone is too loose in two fixtures; the receipt records that limitation explicitly.

Committed bytes, all source-pin ancestry, official archive validation and both read-only Git-free export replays pass, with all 22 exported files unchanged. No production Tensor/native execution, selected cold admission, Lean, Docker, independent human proof review, interval-backend acceptance or full multiplication calculation was run. The full-history wrapper is unpassed in this shallow checkout. The next task is to fund one actual production policy and price source bit work and physical delivery together.

Hosted [run 39995095815](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39995095815) passed planning and the registered Linux replay for published head `234142af90b5e7afe0b33c4b78c3c0bd622d5fc3`. Hosted execution is separate from independent scientific review.
